## 5hh. cc13-confirm B: the torpedo done tick's disarmed arm 009D29E0 (cc9-lua60, 2026-10-14)

`kTorpedoDoneDisarmedArmBound` (packet `cc9_l60_torpedo_disarmed`, committed OFF). In `done` the enter leaves +98h = -1.0,
so 009D2753 JBE always takes 009D29E0-009D2CF1, which `torpedo_done_prepare_tick_009d2720` reduced to `kIdle`. Read whole
from the disk listing; the arithmetic is `bsp::torpedo_done_disarmed_arm_009d29e0` (include/bsp/torpedo_task_arm.hpp):
- EDI = [ctl+3D0h], the squadron's first member; none: nothing written (009D29E2).
- ratio = |aim.xz - leader.xz| / (record+8h TorpReleaseDistFar x approach+24h) x IP(150 -> 1, 500 -> 3; leader.y), where aim
  is approach->vtable[0] (the target point, 009C40A0 on the dive-bomb approach; taken here as the target's position).
- Unless leader.y < 300 (00CE3AE8) and ratio < 3.5 (00D0C308 double): +8Ch = 1.0 (009D2CDA).
- Close: cmd+2C8h = IP(1 -> 0.3, 2.2 -> 1.5; ratio) (009D2B1D), approach+A4h = 3, [approach+1Ch]+40h = 0; then
  h = |wrap(HeadingAngle(aim - leader) - leader vtable[50h])|, b1 = ratio < 1.6 ? IP(0.3 -> 80 deg, 1.6 -> 30 deg) :
  IP(1.6 -> 30 deg, 3 -> 10 deg), w = ratio > 1.5 ? IP(2 -> 2.5, 3.5 -> 1) : IP(0.3 -> 1, 1.5 -> 2.5),
  c = clamp((1.2 - h / b1) x 5, 0, 1), +8Ch = 1 + (w - 1) c.

Correction to cc13's write-up: cmd+2C8h is the bank cap (docs/PILOT_PLANNER_PITCH_ROLL.md section 2; the host's
`plan_state.bank_limit_2c8`), not a throttle, and the "own point" is the aim point, so ratio measures the LEADER's
distance to the target. state+8Ch is republished into squadron+3E8h by 009BFDA6-009BFDB2; the host has no reader of
either, so it is logged only. approach+A4h and [approach+1Ch]+40h have no host cell. Note also that the host's
TorpedoArmBinding drops every `write_command_float` (game_hosts_units.cpp, a no-op), so the armed branch's cmd+2C8h = 0.3
is not applied either; that is outside this switch.

Host wiring: after `torpedo_task_arm_009d4850`, when the done tick ran disarmed, with a first member and a target, the
switch runs the arm and writes `bank_limit_2c8` on the close arm; per slot `torpedo <name> disarmed 009D29E0: ticks close
min_ratio last_8c` in the summary. Prediction: on USN04 (no plan, 9000 frames) the done-state Kates run the arm every
tick; the close arm fires only while the leader is low and within about 2.3 km of the target, capping the bank at
0.3-1.5 rad; no RNG; releases unchanged (0 for the stuck squadron); small trajectory moves for those Kates only.

## 5hi. cc13-confirm C: 007F23A0's five formation shapes and the drop-kamikaze shape 3 (cc9-lua60, 2026-10-14)

**007F23A0 read whole** (disk listing 007F23A0-007F28FD, `local\l60_7f23a0.asm`). The jump table at 007F2900 maps shape
1 -> 007F2576, 2 -> 007F25BD, 3 -> 007F2739, 4 -> 007F26AD, 5 -> 007F2838 (the host's comment had 3 and 4 swapped).
With P the pair number, I the raw formation index (the argument, [ESP+C4h]), M the squadron's +3E8h, sx the lateral
spacing and (dy, dz) the triple's other two components:
- 1: (P sx M, P dy M, P dz M).
- 2: x = P sx max(2M - 1, 0.8), y = P dy clamp(2.2 - 1.2M, 0, 1), z = P dz / max(1, M); the flag pair BL/[ESP+1Bh] = (0.2 > M).
- 3: y = P dy M. With the tuning singleton's +3E8h byte set: x = M f(sx P) + (1 - M) f(0.15 sx I), z = M f(dz P) +
  (1 - M) f(0.8 dz I) (f = float store). Clear: x = P sx (0.7M + 0.3), z = P dz (0.25M + 0.75).
- 4: x = P sx max(1 + 0.8(M - 1), 0.4), y = P dy clamp(2.4 - 1.4M, 0, 1), z = P dz (0.8M + 0.2); flag as shape 2.
- 5: (P sx, 0, 0).
- Tail: an odd index negates x; y and z are negated unless the flag is set or the singleton's +3E9h / +3E8h byte is set.
At M = 1 shapes 2, 3 and 4 give shape 1's station (shape 4's lateral max(1, 0.4) = 1; shape 3's blends collapse), so
with the host's morale fixed at 1.0 (no writer of squadron+3E8h; 009BFDA6 republishes state+8Ch, see 5hh) a shape change
moves nothing. Reconstructed in `bsp::plane_formation_station_007f23a0` without a switch: no host path set a shape
other than 1 before this packet.

### 5hv.1 Cause (USNOS wave 2, `cc9-ships44\local\s52_d_a7.log`, exe 25fbdcba0)

- Squadron `plane #4.4` (leader plus `|.-2/-3/-4`, LevelBomb on TroopTrans4) releases at 416-443 s. TroopTrans4
  dies at 443.62 s; `kSquadronDeadTargetRetestBound` runs 0071E430 and clears every live member's
  `command_target_plus_one` (`squadron retest: "plane #4.4" target TroopTrans4 dead at 443.62 s`).
- The three wingmen's level-bomb arms stop there: each shows `ticks=1235` (320.20 s + 1235 x 0.1 s = 443.7 s) in
  the summary, `-2` and `-4` frozen in goaway and `-3` in release. The host arm
  (`run_level_bomb_task_arm_009b8b50`) returns early on a cleared target while the class is still levelbomb, so
  the task is neither ticked nor retired. The plane keeps its last steering plan, which is the dead-straight
  southbound course lua62 saw: goaway's heading 009B5760/009B5845 never runs again.

  `returntobase` is issued. #4.5 and #4.6, whose target lived, did reach B5 at 443.67 and 450.46 s.

  target the factory 009B9030 passed (EDX) to 009B7990. A cleared target resolves to null, so the answer is 0 and

## 5hw. Attack tasks retire on a lost or changed target; the +3Eh writer (cc9-lua64, 2026-10-17)

### 5hw.1 The vt[40h] rule in the other attack tasks

- 009C8060 (dive bomb), 009D3EF0 (torpedo) and 009AE140 (drop kamikaze) are the same body as 009B81F0: 2 without a
  director (`[task+404h]`), else 1 only when `0071BE40` is the task's class (00E08F20 / 00E08F18 / 00E08F30) or
  00E08F78, and `[task+440h]` (torpedo `[task+4C4h]`) is 0 or equals the command's resolved target
  (`0071EB60` -> `00521EA0`). 0099A4C0 asks it on every bot think (0099AE7E, docs/CC13_BOT_TASK_CADENCE.md) and pops
  a head that answers 0; the tail jump 0099A5EB -> 0099A170 then builds a task for the current command, and all
  three classes need a target there (dive bomb and drop kamikaze also IsKind(2), torpedo 009229F0;
  src/attack_commands.cpp). So a cleared target leaves the member with no task, and a new target gives it a fresh
  task.
- Host: the dive-bomb arm keeps its task on any target (its moveto tick returns on a null target), the torpedo arm
  returns early on a null target before anything and keeps the task on a new target, and the drop-kamikaze arm
  returns early on a null target (it already re-installs on a new one). After `kSquadronDeadTargetRetestBound`
  clears a member's target (ESMP08 reference `l63rt_e8_ref.log`: 14 retests, 12 torpedo and 2 dive bomb, 9 at 420.02 s on
  South Dakota), those members freeze in their last state, and 009F7C90 still reads their stale break-off answers.
- `kAttackTaskTargetRetireBound` (game_hosts_units.cpp, committed OFF). True: an installed task whose recorded
  target (`db_task_target_plus_one`, `torpedo_task_target_plus_one`, `dkz_target_plus_one`) is not the member's
  command target retires (`<task> task <unit>: retired, the command target is not the task's (<vt40>)`), and a
  non-null new target installs a fresh task at once. LABELLED: the torpedo re-install after a retarget skips the
  2Bh ordnance pick (the director's class is unchanged, so 0099A170 builds MakeTorpedo again); the 00E08F78
  acceptance and the class-change half of vt[40h] are not modelled (the dive and torpedo arms still keep their
  task under another class, as before). Summary line `summary attack task target retire bound=<0|1> retires=<n>`.
- Predictions (reference env, plans as the last re-time): ESMP08 `p12_e8_rb` ON logs torpedo retires for the
  live members of the nine squadrons retested at 420.02 s, at that time or one think later, and later ones at each
  further retest (Helldiver dive-bomb retires at 4857 s / 6793 s if the run still gets there); planes then fly
  without a task instead of holding their last state, so the row moves after 420 s. USN04 (no orders) and JM08
  `l62_j8_w1`: retires only where a retest or an order retarget happens; identical otherwise.

### 5hw.2 The +3Eh writer is 0084DA60 (read, not bound)

- 0084DA60 is slot 70h of the squadron command block's vtable 00D0BD98 (stored by 0084D849 in
  BSP_PlaneSquadronCommandBlock_Construct), overriding 0071EDD0, `__thiscall(block)(descriptor, flag)`, `RET 8`
  (listing 0084DA60-0084DADA). It resolves the offered descriptor, and the block's slot-0 descriptor `+58h` (flag
  set) or override `+18Ch` (flag clear); calls 0071EDD0 with the same arguments; returns 0 when that answers 0;
  when it answers 1 and the two objects differ it returns 1; when they are the same object it sets
  `[[block+38h]+3Eh] = 1` unless `[[00E188A8]+1FE4h] == 2`, and returns 0.
- Its caller is 0071DDB0, the observed-target release (GUNNERY_OPEN_ITEMS, `kDirectorTargetChecksBound`): on a
  slot-0 target's death the descriptor IS `+58h`, so for a ship target (0071EDD0 rewrites it to the position
  branch and answers 1) the block sets +3Eh and skips the stage raise 0071D810. A plane target with a live
  squadron member is re-pointed by 0071EDD0 (answer 0): no +3Eh.
- `[block+38h]` is the free-attack controller (vtable 00D21C00, CC13_SEG68 section 1); 009F840C forces +3Dh from
  +3Eh, but only on the general path: the seven ordnance classes return or jump to 009F8412 before it, and a
  category 1/2 command whose resolved target is null (the position branch) also jumps to 009F8412. So +3Eh adds
  nothing for an attack order; it matters only for a non-attack-category slot-0 command whose observed target
  dies (no such squadron command is seen in the rows).
- Host: nothing writes +3Eh, and the host does not model 0084DA60 (the delivery `release_observed_target_0071ddb0`
  runs the generic 0071EDD0 for every director). The ordnance classes' +3Dh is the existing retest; the strafe /
  dogfight / settarget squadrons' 009F8412 on a null target is not hosted (`kSquadronDeadTargetRetestBound` skips
  every non-ordnance class). Not bound in this packet; recorded as an open item.

class 27 (1Bh MLandFort), and `007EEC50 -> 00000000` with gb=1; 007F1688 then issues moveto (5hl L3). The host's chooser

plane, squadron, ship family, airfield (45h), shipyard (46h) or 1Ch reaches 00922D3F..00922D5B, 008DDF90 over the local

## 5id. PutTo / PutFormationTo: heading, reshape and the formation arms (cc9-lua66, 2026-10-17)

Packet `cc9_l66_putto`, switch `bsp::game::kPutToFormationBound` (include/bsp/game_hosts_units.hpp), committed OFF.
Sources: docs/CC13_VERIFY4.md R4/R5, CC13_VERIFY12.md R8; the listing of 008193A0, 008196B0, 009584D0, 0047F200, 00B646E0.

- **Heading, 008196B0** (vtable +11Ch): 009584D0 -> 0047F200 builds RotationY(-0.0 - heading) (00B646E0 stores
  m[0] = cos, m[2] = -sin, the D3DX form) times the translation of the current position, so the host heading
  atan2(row2.x, row2.z) is the negated argument. Then 00818EA0 refills the wake ring, and an occupant owner (00778890:
  group+14h == unit, the leader) re-places every other member through vtable[118h](&00F87574, the zero vector).
  `GameUnitsHost::set_heading_008196b0`. LABELLED: ships only (IsKindOf 6); the +BCCh 1.25 and vtable[0D8h] have no host
  counterpart; pitch and roll are dropped as 0047F200 does.
- **Placement, 008193A0**: a follower asked for a point with |pos|^2 <= 25.0 (00CE3880) is placed at its station
  (0081945D-0081950A: 00810630 on the leader's wake at the record's axial column, pushed by the lateral column along
  (-dir.z, dir.x), y = 0), i.e. `formation_station_0070d290(unit, 1, 1)`, then turned by vtable[11Ch](-0.0 -
  wrap_2pi(pi/2 - atan2(dir.z, dir.x))) with the float-widened constants 00CE3830 / 00CE3828. A far point places nothing.
  A leader re-places every other member at the origin (00819672). The OFF arm is unchanged (followers refused, the snap
  a record).
- **Reshape, 0070EFD0(shape)**: `reshape_formation_0070efd0` runs `ship_ai_formation_reshape` over the group's records
  with ShipGlobals.Formacio.FormationShipDist (settings+42Ch). 0070EFD0 does not write group+500h, and the host's
  column is always 0, so the rewritten column is the live one.
- The script-orders half (PutTo with exactly three arguments, 008AA10E `cmp eax, 3`, heading = float(arg * 00CE3D28) /
  00CE3D20 as for PutFormationTo's four; PutFormationTo's reshape before the move) follows when that file's lease frees.

Prediction (USN02 `s36_u2_p7`, PRCP01, JM08 `luaJM8USFormation`): PutFormationTo at usn_02 :985 / :990 reshapes the
group (shape 1 then 3) and its followers jump onto their stations at the new point, turned along the leader's wake;
PutTo with a heading turns the unit and, for a leader, snaps the formation. Rows that call neither are identical.

## 5im. SquadronSetTravelSpeed 008A0630 (cc9-lua68, 2026-10-18, packet l68_travel_speed)

`kLuaSquadronSetTravelSpeedBound` (include/bsp/game_hosts_units.hpp) is committed OFF with this section.

**The native.** 008A0630 `SquadronSetTravelSpeed(squadron, speed[, force])`:
- argument 1 goes through 00B66270 and is stored as a float (FSTP 008A076C);
- argument 2 goes through 00B66250 only when 00B663F0 counts exactly 3 arguments;
- then four stores: 008A07E2 +388h = [00CE3800] (0.5), 008A07F0 +38Fh = force, 008A07FA +3A0h = speed, 008A0802
  +3ACh = 1.

Body: src/cc13_left55_seg56a.cpp `lua_squadron_set_travel_speed`. It is the fourth timer / freeze / value / lock
quadruple. The squadron tick 007F3BAA counts the four countdowns +37Ch..+388h down while their freeze bytes
+38Ch..+38Fh are clear (docs/TICK_ELEMENT_OVERRIDES.md).

**Who else writes +3A0h** (byte scan of the disp32 forms over 007C0000-009CFFFF; MOVSS, FLD/FSTP, MOV and SIB forms
checked):
- 007ED590 SquadronRestoreTravelSpeed's body and 007F1FE0 (order begin): +388h = 0.5, +3A0h = class
  [squadron+35Ch]+190h, +3ACh = 1, +38Fh = 0.
- 007ED5D0 RefreshTravelSpeed: unless +38Fh, when +388h < 0 and +3ACh is clear, +3A0h = the class value; then +3ACh
  = 0. Its only caller is BSP_PilotBot_Tick 0099AEA3. That call runs only when the bot's head task before 0099A4C0
  (EDI, 0099AE6C) differs from the one after (EBX, 0099AE92), and only when plane+9D4h is set.

**Readers of +3A0h:**
- 009C185C (moveto desired speed, 009C1850);
- 009C23BE (moveto target speed, 009C23B0);
- 009BC909 (move-on-path tick);

The host used the class value at all four. Two more host sites, 009C204C and the depth-charge class block, read
desc+190h directly and are unchanged.

**So a script speed without `force` lasts until the second head-task change of any member** that comes at least
0.5 s after the call. The first change only clears the lock. With `force` it lasts until 007ED590 or 007F1FE0
rewrites it. No shipped mission passes `force`.

**The native** 008AA560 `PutRelTo(unit, ref, rel[, heading])`, from the listing:
- arguments 0 and 1 go through 00888AA0, argument 2 through 00888760 as a Vector3;
- ref's world matrix (+0CCh, 16 dwords) is copied after 00414DB0 refreshes it, and 004142E0 transforms rel as a
  row-vector affine point (x*row0 + y*row1 + z*row2 + translation) into the copy's translation;
- 008AA764-008AA787: when the unit answers IsKindOf(6) and not IsKindOf(8), the point's y is 0;
- vtable[114h] (0080E150, the weapon director getter) and, for IsKindOf(2), 007788B0 run with results unused;
- vtable[120h] (00819840: 009585B0 SetWorldMatrix, 0092D620, 00818EA0) takes the copied matrix, so the unit gets
  ref's rotation and the new point. Unlike vtable[118h] (008193A0) it neither refuses a formation follower nor
  snaps a leader's group;
- with exactly four arguments (008AA7CF) argument 3 * 00CE3D28 / 00CE3D20 goes to vtable[11Ch] (008196B0);
- vtable[0D8h], then for an occupant owner (00778890, the group's leader) every other member through
  vtable[118h](&00F87574) and vtable[0D8h] (008AA851-008AA897). No result.

wake ring; the script orders host then applies the heading and the leader's `relocate_formation_members_00819672`.
LABELLED: only a ship (IsKindOf 6) is posed, as for 008196B0; the controller sync is the motion state itself; float
arithmetic stands in for the main thread's 24-bit x87 precision.
